title: Total Divisor Count
statement:
Let `d(i)` be the number of divisors of `i`. For each query `n`, print `d(1) + d(2) + ... + d(n)`.

## Input
The first line contains `q`. Each of the next `q` lines contains one number `n`.

## Output
Print `q` lines, the answer for each query.

## Constraints
- `1 <= q <= 10`
- `1 <= n <= 10^10`
